comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. Board (mitcad#2226): the FEFCO 0471 folder, the 0470 with a front flap with ears on its lid. First of C flute corrugated board (4 mm, crease deduction 4, crease radius 0.5: each crease develops 5; the seam gap 0.4), inside 300 x 200 x 150. The blank (sketch F2, its outline with two slots), its creases (sketch F3), the Face F4 and sixteen Folds F5 to F20: the end walls on the back wall's ends with their floor flaps and turned over with a tab each into the floor flap, the front wall's end flaps between the end walls' layers, the lid with its front flap, the height less the thickness (146) deep, inside the front wall, its ears inside the end walls. Its blank from x = -152 to 705.6 (the front flap), y = -204 to 529.6.
It unfolds to its blank with the crease allowances.
Its die line: cut and crease layers for a cutting table, and as PDF.
Edited to 180 high: the walls 30 higher, the front flap 176 deep, the blank from x = -182 to 765.6; its Face and Folds follow.
Then of 4 mm corrugated polypropylene (crease deduction 0.4: each crease develops 8.6), inside 160 x 90 x 60: its rules F21, Face F24 and Folds F25 to F40, a second sheet body.
